<description>
From the discussion in #36403, it is clear that there needs to be a way for users to rebroadcast a transaction. Currently, the way to do so requires getting the raw transaction, getting the hex, and using `sendrawtransaction`. This PR adds `rebroadcastwallettx` RPC that takes a txid to attempt to rebroadcast that single transaction. An action is also added to the GUI menu for each transaction to do the same.
</description>
